expected_total_detail: Unified NBA Structural v9 totals engine. Decoupled additive half-pace adjustment (+0.55 pts/poss), B2B drag (-0.8 poss), 3-in-4 schedule fatigue (-0.6 pts), sample-maturity scaled close-game OT risk (+1.2 pts * sample/15), and 15% replacement-aware injury shrinkage.
expected_total_formula: (away_points + home_points) + 0.55 * (est_possessions - 99.2) with sample-scaled OT adjustment (+1.2 * min(1, games/15) if abs(margin) <= 3.5)
note: nba-total-margin-v9-1 total engine (B5 rolling baseline, B6 fitted fatigue, B7 playoff offset) unchanged; the final P(over) is served as sigmoid(0.105 * logit(p)), intercept 0, so no side is favoured. Player availability (B9) is not applied: v9.1 never fitted it. Train-window fit MLE 0.105 (SE 0.092); see outputs/nba/v10_harness/v92_total_shrink.md.
prediction_formula: P(over) = sigmoid(probability_logit_slope * logit(1 - normal_cdf(total_line, expected_total, effective_total_sd)))
